title: This week’s exposure therapy: speaking up in lectures! #engineeringdegree #exposuretherapy
transcript: The most productive thing you can do in your lectures is to arrive, be present, ask questions. Why? It's a really good way to give yourself a bit of exposure therapy. You're speaking in public. All the attention goes on you. Everybody's looking. And guess what? Not everyone even has the confidence to ask a question in a lecture hall. There is a small chance you might look stupid. That's just part of it. You may think it's an obvious question, but it's not. I am so sure that the problem you're facing, you're not understanding, is a similar problem to someone else. I found that when I've asked questions, questions follow up with that.
